title: Throughput and residence-time comparisons for waste-pyrolysis test lines
summary: A Suneng proposal groups circuit boards, waste plastics, organic coatings and photovoltaic panels into four test lines for one project. The first three use continuous-feed capacity, while the photovoltaic line converts batch weight into hourly throughput. Distinguish those measurement bases before comparing actual material, loading and complete cycles; four kg/h figures alone are not a valid comparison.
